## 5fd7ea0a8e2a

**Issue found: all ordinary samples contain exactly one matching-size red
component, so “recolor only the first match” fits both canonical data and the
generator.** The intended rule quantifies over every red component, but the
constructor places one target-size blob and explicitly forces all remaining
sizes away from the target.

Exact counterexample:

```text
010100000
000000000
022002200
000000000
000000000
```

There are two blue markers, so both separate red dominos have the target area
2. The intended output is:

```text
010100000
000000000
033003300
000000000
000000000
```

A row-major “recolor the first matching object only” rival outputs:

```text
010100000
000000000
033002200
000000000
000000000
```

The rival matches all canonical train/test pairs because each has only one
matching object. A direct census of 200 generated boards per difficulty band
found exactly one match on **600/600** boards (`easy`, `medium`, and `hard` each
200/200). The proposed generator therefore does not emit the needed
multiple-match witness. Reproduction details are in
`checks/build_audit_evidence.py` and `checks/audit-manual-evidence.json`.
